# Vendored Wallabag route snapshot

Derived from [wallabag/wallabag](https://github.com/wallabag/wallabag) tag `2.6.15` (MIT).

`routes.json` lists every `@Route` in the ApiBundle REST controllers named in the connector brief, plus `DeveloperController` HTML routes so the generator can exclude them with a reason.

This file is a route table, not Wallabag PHP. Do not copy GPL or AGPL third-party packages from a Wallabag install.

Regenerate `src/operations.ts` with `npm run gen:operations`.
